data.one_liner: Display widgets in a circle with customizable radius and spacing.
data.what_it_does: This package allows developers to arrange and display widgets in a circular pattern. It provides options to control the radius of the center circle, surrounding items, inner spacing, and drawing configurations.
use_when: You need to display a set of widgets in a circular layout.
You want to customize the radius, start angle, and direction of circular items.
avoid_when: You need standard linear or grid layouts.
You require complex animations not supported by the package.
strengths: Allows control over radius, inner spacing, and item arrangement.
Supports customization options like clock-wise drawing, start angles, and draw order.
data.minimal_example:
CircularWidgets(
  centerWidget: Text('Center'),
  items: [
    Text('Item 1'),
    Text('Item 2'),
  ],
)
